analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price (58,435 KRW) below SMA5 (62,244 KRW) and SMA20 (70,025 KRW): diagnosing short-term and mid-term weak trends.
· Significantly lower position relative to SMA100 (116,902 KRW) and SMA200 (113,058 KRW): indicating weakened long-term trend strength.
· 52-week position (9.6%) + Current price level is higher than the 52-week low (37,815 KRW), but extremely low compared to the 52-week high (252,500 KRW).
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (42.7 → 30.0): entering oversold territory, continuing downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1021.6646 → -762.4665): continued worsening, strengthening bearish trend.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band 55,128 KRW): approaching the lower band, suggesting potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support level (41,000 KRW): based on 52-week low, a key defense line in case of decline.
· Swing resistance level (80,380 KRW): requires confirmation of trend reversal if broken.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: 5-day low at 51,065 KRW, 20-day low at 51,065 KRW identical, indicating potential for sideways movement or Lower High formation.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.86): contracted compared to the 5-day average, lowering the reliability of current movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (downtrend): condition to maintain a wait-and-see approach until buying pressure is confirmed.
